# Agent

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:Agent`](gmeow-Agent.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Agent>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/kernel`](../../slices/kernel.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

An entity that can act, bear responsibility, and enter into agreements: a person, an organization, or a software agent.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Entity`](gmeow-Entity.md), [`gufo:FunctionalComplex`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-functionalcomplex)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:Agent`](gmeow-Agent.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:Entity`](gmeow-Entity.md), [`gufo:FunctionalComplex`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-functionalcomplex). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for the bearer of action, responsibility, authorship, agreement, or trust — the domain of contribution, attestation, and provenance roles whenever the participant is a person, organization, or software agent.

### Avoid when

- Avoid for things that are merely acted upon or that carry information without acting (use [`PhysicalObject`](gmeow-PhysicalObject.md) or [`InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md)); avoid asserting bare [`gmeow:Agent`](gmeow-Agent.md) when [`Person`](gmeow-Person.md) or [`Organization`](gmeow-Organization.md) is meant.

### How to use

- Type the participant as [`Agent`](gmeow-Agent.md) (or a [`Person`](gmeow-Person.md)/Organization specialization) and link it through role relators — contribution, attribution, party-to-agreement — rather than flattening agency into a single attribute.

### Examples

- ex:lillith a [`gmeow:Agent`](gmeow-Agent.md); [`gmeow:hasName`](../properties/gmeow-hasName.md) ex:lillithName.
